column1: # Campaign 28 Stage B client-go source evidence for real normal optimistic 2PC.

column5: The bounded normal optimistic path uses real PD start and commit timestamps, strict immutable Insert and PutExisting mutations, deterministic-primary region batching, real Prewrite and synchronous primary-before-secondary Commit, canonical region recovery and regrouping, older-lock resolution with same-start-ts retry, newer-lock conflict without resolution, and truthful publication-boundary outcomes over one shared process authority. Async commit, one-phase commit, pessimistic transactions, pipelined mode, TTL manager heartbeats, binlog, explicit transactions, savepoints, and unbounded large transactions remain unclaimed.

Every possibly-prewritten key is synchronously regrouped and sent through real BatchRollback before a definitive non-commit is reported; exact failed keys, routes, publications, and typed recovery causes remain in the receipt. Background cleanup, resolve-lock batching, async cleanup, and unrelated cleanup commands remain unclaimed.

The concrete opener derives from an already-running SharedReadOpener and cloned PdClient without reconnecting or starting workers, allocates a real start timestamp, keeps snapshot reads and writes on the same nonzero authority identity, and exposes explicit zero-write or consuming commit completion. General client-go transaction options, explicit transaction APIs, savepoints, pessimistic mode, staging, and arbitrary KV mutation semantics remain unclaimed.
